title: 第19章 自作自受第20章 冤家路窄
lines: 程焕真对着高山说道：“高山啊，别叫什么程老了。以后叫我老师。”
看不上附二院归看不上，可高山也不是忍气吞声的人。此时此刻，有这么好的机会，高山可不会放过。虽然不能把冯忠华和赵瑞晨怎么样，可给他们添堵的事情，高山还是很乐意做的。
程焕真笑得合不拢嘴，直接拉着高山，道：“高山啊，我们走，你去准备一下，等下就跟我去中医研究院那边，我们就不打扰林院长管理医院了。”
程焕真此刻的表现真的是符合他这个名字，人如其名，果然是纯真做派，脸上那种得意，就跟小孩子抢到了心爱的糖果一样。至于其他人会不会高兴。他才不会管。他自己高兴就行了。
术业有专攻，如果程焕真除了医学还要懂得人情世故，还要懂得交际应酬，那这个世界顶多就多出一个官员，绝对不会出现一个大师。
林小元颇为无奈，又好气又好笑的看着程焕真嘚瑟。至于高山，还真没有那么在意。不就是一个学生么？天赋再好那也只是学生。他见过的天才也不在少数，能真正成为大师的又有几个？不过高山有这种自信，林小元以后怕是做梦都会后悔今天放走了自己。
林小元颇有深意的看了冯忠华和赵瑞晨一眼。虽然不至于怎么着这两人，至少也是有了一些看法了。而这就是高山的目的。他从来没有奢求这几句话就能让冯忠华和赵瑞晨生不如死。以他高山现在的实力和能力来说——他还不够格。
可林小元却还是冷眼看着冯忠华，沉声道：“冯处长，看来你很闲啊。一个实习生的事情都这么追着？正好，接下来全院要承办部里的医疗学术年会，那就由你去操办吧。至于这个同学，你一个实习生不好好学习，跟着起什么哄。凑什么热闹。冯处长，这个人一定要全院通报批评。”
这话一出，如果是正常的途径，那就等于是把赵瑞晨留在附二院的希望和机会都给堵死了。冯忠华连连点头，他算是明白自作自受是什么意思了。自己现在就是自作自受的典型。
看着林小元离去的背影，冯忠华心中叹息。这么一下，自己以后的升迁恐怕也要受影响了。再看旁边的赵瑞晨，冯忠华气不打一处来，直接就训斥道：“还跟着干嘛？你不要实习么？”
“山山啊。”程焕真一出门就很是亲密的称呼起来。
高山顿时有些尴尬，讪笑着道：“程老，叫我小高也行，叫我高山也行。”
“哦！”程老拖长的声音响起，嘀咕道：“也对，山山这个称呼有些太女性化了，那行，我叫你小高吧。今天就收拾一下，你明天去研究院报到。我会安排下去的，电话、名片那些东西我可没有。”
程焕真直接说着，没有名片和电话，听起来不可思议，这都什么年代了。竟然还有人没有手机？可放在程老身上还真有这个可能。
就在此刻，旁边一个脆声响起：“高山你回来啦。”
转头望去叶岚俏生生的站在了花坛旁边。今天的叶岚穿着的一件略显宽松的圆领休闲T恤，配上紧身塑形的弹力牛仔裤。近一米七的身材完美的展现了出来，挺翘的丰盈，修长的大长腿给人一种遐想。粟色的长发扎成的发髻盘在脑后，却又恰到好处的将白皙的脖颈给展现了出来。白大褂敞开着如同风衣一样，走起路来偏偏生风。一件工作服，硬是被叶岚穿出了时装的感觉。
程焕真此刻却是爽朗笑着道：“好小子，不错啊，有眼光。加油啊，争取把附二院的人给我拐带回去。”
叶岚被程老这话闹得有些羞涩了，高山更是无比的尴尬，看着程老那挑眉弄眼的样子，这哪里是院士，哪里是人称南程北周的中医大师。这简直就是一个老顽童嘛。
高山有些无奈，道：“程老师，您老就先回去吧。”
看着程老慢悠悠的离去，高山这才看着叶岚，有些尴尬道：“叶岚，这…程老他喜欢开玩笑，你别介意啊。”
叶岚眼神中，有那么一些说不清、道不明的情绪一闪而逝，转而就微笑着道：“没事。你家里的事情处理好了么？”
“家里处理完了。”高山应声说着，然后看着叶岚道：“叶岚，刚才赵瑞晨和冯忠华找我了。他们找了几个借口。接下来我就不在附二院实习了。”
“啊！他们怎么能这样。我明明帮你请假了的。他们凭什么开除你。”叶岚有些激动，小脸也是一副气鼓鼓的表情：“不行，我去找他们去。凭什么啊。总得讲道理吧。这不是毁人前途么？”
看着叶岚的样子，高山却显得很开心。如今这个时代，太浮夸了、太现实了；像是叶岚这种女孩，不讲物质，如此正直纯真的女孩子，真的是太少见了。更何况还是为了自己。高山怎么都觉得很骄傲。
拉住了叶岚的手，但是瞬间两人就放开了，一股暧昧的情绪顿时衍生出来。高山笑着道：“没事，刚才这个程老你看到了，程老是我们定南省中医研究院的中医大师，更是国家科学院的院士，他就是中医界人称南程北周的程焕真教授，程老邀请我去中医研究院跟他学习，去读他的硕博连读班。我已经答应了。”
叶岚愣着了，有些疑惑和担心的看着高山，左右上下一通打量，诧异道：“学中医？你有基础么？我听说中医可难背了。你能跟得上？不过能够硕博连读也是好的。如今学医对学历的要求越来越高了。最早中专生就行，后来本科也算勉强，可现在不是硕士、博士都不敢来医院应聘了。”
高山哈哈一笑，点头道：“放心，我可是祖传的老中医。”
“哼！你就贫吧，到时候背那些汤头歌诀什么的，我看你头不头疼。”叶岚也傲娇的调侃起来。
“对了。”叶岚接着道：“既然事情都已经这样，你也算是塞翁失马焉知非福了。那正好就约着几个人一起聚聚。今天忙碌一天，正好晚上也不要值班，还可以去唱歌。就当是给你庆祝了。”
说着，叶岚也不等高山说话，直接就拿出手机开始约了起来。
content_en:
Cheng Huanzhen said to Gao Shan: "Gao Shan, don't call me Mr. Cheng. From now on, call me teacher."
He didn't like the Second Affiliated Hospital, but Gao Shan was not one to swallow his anger. At this moment, with such a good opportunity, Gao Shan would not let it go. Although he couldn't do anything to Feng Zhonghua and Zhao Ruichen, Gao Shan was still happy to cause trouble for them.
Cheng Huanzhen smiled from ear to ear, pulled Gao Shan directly, and said: "Gao Shan, let's go, you go get ready, and follow me to the Institute of Traditional Chinese Medicine later, and we won't disturb Dean Lin's management of the hospital."
Cheng Huanzhen's behavior at this moment really fits his name. He is as innocent as his name suggests. The pride on his face is like a child who has snatched his favorite candy. As for whether others will be happy. He doesn't care. As long as he is happy.
There are specialties in medicine. If Cheng Huanzhen also knew how to deal with people and social interactions in addition to medicine, then there would be at most one more official in the world, and there would definitely not be a master.
Lin Xiaoyuan was quite helpless and looked at Cheng Huanzhen's words with annoyance and amusement. As for the mountains, I really don’t care that much. Isn’t he just a student? No matter how talented you are, you are still just a student. He has seen quite a few geniuses. How many of them can truly become masters? However, Gao Shan has such self-confidence that Lin Xiaoyuan will regret letting him go today even in his dreams.
Lin Xiaoyuan glanced at Feng Zhonghua and Zhao Ruichen with deep meaning. Although it doesn't bother these two people, at least they have some opinions. And that’s what mountains are for. He never expected that these few words would make Feng Zhonghua and Zhao Ruichen's lives worse than death. In terms of Gao Shan's current strength and ability - he is not qualified yet.
But Lin Xiaoyuan still looked at Feng Zhonghua coldly and said in a deep voice: "Director Feng, it seems that you are very free. Are you chasing after an intern like this? It just so happens that the whole hospital will host the department's annual medical academic conference, so you can handle it. As for this classmate, if you, an intern, don't study hard, why are you making fun of him? Why are you joining in the fun? Director Feng, this person must be criticized by the whole hospital."
As soon as these words came out, if it was a normal way, it would be equivalent to blocking Zhao Ruichen's hope and opportunity of staying in the Second Affiliated Hospital. Feng Zhonghua nodded repeatedly, he finally understood what it meant to suffer for one's own fault. I am now a typical example of self-inflicted consequences.
Looking at Lin Xiaoyuan's leaving figure, Feng Zhonghua sighed in his heart. If this happens, my future promotion may also be affected. Looking at Zhao Ruichen next to him, Feng Zhonghua was furious and scolded him directly: "Why are you still following me? Don't you want an internship?"
"Shanshan." Cheng Huanzhen called him very intimately as soon as he went out.
Gao Shan suddenly felt embarrassed and said with a smile: "Mr. Cheng, you can call me Xiao Gao or Gao Shan."
"Oh!" Mr. Cheng's protracted voice rang out, and he muttered: "That's right. The name Shanshan is a bit too feminine. Okay, I'll call you Xiao Gao. I'll clean up today and you can report to the institute tomorrow. I'll make arrangements for it. I don't have a phone number or a business card."
Cheng Huanzhen said directly, without a business card or phone number, it sounded incredible, what age is this. There are still people who don’t have mobile phones? But it is really possible when it comes to Mr. Cheng.
At this moment, a crisp voice sounded from the side: "Gao Shan, you are back."
Turning around, I saw Ye Lan standing pretty next to the flower bed. Today, Ye Lan is wearing a slightly loose round-neck casual T-shirt, paired with tight-fitting stretch jeans. The figure of nearly 1.7 meters is perfectly displayed. The plump and slender legs give people a sense of reverie. Her long maroon hair was tied into a bun at the back of her head, but it showed off her fair neck just right. The white coat was open like a windbreaker, and it was windy when he walked. A piece of work clothes was worn by Ye Lan to give it a fashionable feel.
At this moment, Cheng Huanzhen said with a hearty smile: "Good boy, not bad, he has good vision. Come on, try to abduct the people from the Second Affiliated Hospital back to me."
Ye Lan was a little embarrassed by what Mr. Cheng said, and Gao Shan was even more embarrassed. Looking at Mr. Cheng's raised eyebrows, he couldn't tell whether he was an academician or a master of traditional Chinese medicine known as Nan Cheng and Bei Zhou. This is simply an old naughty boy.
Gao Shan was a little helpless and said, "Teacher Cheng, you should go back first."
Watching Mr. Cheng leave slowly, Gao Shan looked at Ye Lan and said with some embarrassment: "Ye Lan, this... Mr. Cheng likes to joke, don't mind."
In Ye Lan's eyes, some indescribable and unexplained emotions flashed away, and then she smiled and said, "It's okay. Have you settled your family affairs?"
"It's all done at home." Gao Shan responded, then looked at Ye Lan and said, "Ye Lan, Zhao Ruichen and Feng Zhonghua came to see me just now. They made several excuses. I will no longer be an intern at the Second Affiliated Hospital."
"Ah! How could they do this? I obviously asked for leave for you. Why should they fire you?" Ye Lan was a little excited, with an angry expression on her face: "No, I'll go find them. Why? You have to be reasonable. Isn't this ruining someone's future?"
Looking at Ye Lan's appearance, Gao Shan looked very happy. Today's era is too exaggerated and too realistic; girls like Ye Lan, who don't care about material things and are so upright and innocent, are really rare. What's more, it's for yourself. Gao Shan feels very proud no matter what.
He held Ye Lan's hand, but the two of them let go in an instant, and an ambiguous emotion suddenly emerged. Gao Shan smiled and said: "It's okay. You saw Mr. Cheng just now. Mr. Cheng is a master of traditional Chinese medicine at our Dingnan Provincial Institute of Traditional Chinese Medicine and an academician of the National Academy of Sciences. He is Professor Cheng Huanzhen of the Southern and Northern Zhou Dynasties, known in the Chinese medicine community. Mr. Cheng invited me to study with him at the Institute of Traditional Chinese Medicine and attend his master's and doctoral program. I have already agreed."
Ye Lan was stunned, looking at Gao Shan with some doubts and worries, looking up and down, and said in surprise: "Studying Chinese medicine? Do you have the basics? I heard that Chinese medicine is difficult to memorize. Can you keep up? But it is also good to be able to study for a master's degree and a Ph.D. Nowadays, the academic requirements for studying medicine are getting higher and higher. At first, a technical secondary school student was enough, and later a bachelor's degree was considered acceptable, but now even if you don't have a master's degree or a doctorate, you don't dare to come to the hospital to apply."
Gao Shan laughed, nodded and said: "Don't worry, I am an old Chinese medicine doctor passed down from my ancestors."
"Hmph! Just be poor. I don't think you'll have a headache when you memorize those soup chants and stuff." Ye Lan also teased arrogantly.
"That's right." Ye Lan continued: "Since things have turned out like this, you can be regarded as a blessing in disguise. Then I just made an appointment with a few people to get together. It's a busy day today, and I don't have to be on duty at night, so I can go sing. I'll treat it as a celebration for you."
With that said, Ye Lan didn't wait for Gao Shan to speak, and directly took out her cell phone and started making an appointment.
title_en: Chapter 19 It’s your own fault Chapter 20 Enemies meet on a narrow road
